description: This file defines an acceptance test class 'OpportunitiesCest' for SuiteCRM. It contains test scenarios for viewing and creating opportunities, including interactions with accounts and opportunities modules, utilizing Faker for test data generation.

classes.name: OpportunitiesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Opportunities module in SuiteCRM, testing view and create functionalities with dependencies injected via method parameters.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, creates Faker instance and seeds random data.

methods.name: testScenarioViewOpportunitiesModule
methods.description: Test to verify that the Opportunities module view loads correctly.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateOpportunity
methods.description: Test to create and then delete an Opportunity and associated Account, verifying the process for administrative users.
